title: Rocker panel trim gap and instrument panel mentions
summary: This topic combines one complaint about rocker panel trim fit and damage with several instrument panel mentions that do not clearly express sentiment.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a front passenger-side rocker panel with an abnormal gap, possible trim fastener misalignment, observed underside damage, and unresolved repair coverage.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention instrument panel technology, control placement, and turn-signal indicator behavior without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: The sample is small and mostly undetermined, so concrete conclusions are limited.
The topic cluster mixes rocker panel trim issues with instrument panel mentions, which are not clearly the same subject.
One negative review contributes multiple fragments, so the evidence is concentrated in a single case.
